description: Carried on the NMUSAF Aircraft on Loan by Location list to OR-NG Oregon Military Museum Clackamas; previously served with the Republic of Korea Air Force; reassembled at the museum in late February 2020 as a centrepiece exhibit representing Oregon Air National Guard Korean War service; displayed wearing the marking 12892 which is not this aircraft's serial
Reported in the museum's outdoor Historic Park display; serial not established and not independently confirmed
